test_case_name: Access Contact Us page from Cookie Policy and initiate chat

intents.intent: Click 'Contact us' link on the Cookie Policy page
Click 'Let's Chat' link on the Contact Us page
And then check that the chat interface or chat article is displayed

test_case_name: Access Contact Us page from Cookie Policy and search for information

intents.intent: Click 'Contact us' link on the Cookie Policy page
Type $name into the 'I am looking for…' search input on the Contact Us page
Click 'Search' button on the Contact Us page
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the query

test_case_name: Access Contact Us page from Cookie Policy and open Queries/Feedback form

Click 'Queries/Feedback' link on the Contact Us page
